summary: A rebuilt Flight Planner: click the chart to draw the route, a DEP / route / ARR bar, a legs table and waypoints across the whole chart.
releaseNotes: Flight Planner: every chart click adds the waypoint under it and draws the leg; the first click picks the departure airport.
A route bar with DEP, the route as text and ARR. Type fixes or coordinates and press Enter; unknown idents are named, not guessed.
A legs table with the route, track, leg distance and running total for every point.
Waypoints from the simulator data now cover the whole chart: the new Fit view radius follows the zoom, and fixes are hidden only when zoomed far out.
The planner is four tabs (Route, Procedures, Fuel, Review) instead of a six-step wizard, and the planned route is drawn in magenta.
Planned route lines were not drawn on the EFB maps since 2.2.0; the Flight Planner and the Navigator show them again.
The Flight Planner chart no longer freezes for most of a second each time it is panned or zoomed.
Reopening the Flight Planner starts the chart at the plan instead of the default map.
